module_summary: Multi-cycle IEEE-754 single-precision multiplier: a free-running 3-bit counter steps unpack, special-case, normalize, mantissa multiply, round and pack phases over shared field registers.

anchors.name: counter
anchors.why: Step counter acting as sequencer; each value enables one phase (unpack...pack).

anchors.name: product
anchors.why: 50-bit mantissa product, source of result mantissa and rounding bits.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Packed IEEE-754 result, also written with NaN/Inf/zero special cases.

anchors.name: a_mantissa
anchors.why: Unpacked, denormalized/normalized operand A mantissa feeding the multiplier.

anchors.name: b_mantissa
anchors.why: Unpacked, denormalized/normalized operand B mantissa feeding the multiplier.

anchors.name: a_exponent
anchors.why: Unbiased operand A exponent; checked for NaN/Inf/zero, summed into z_exponent.

anchors.name: b_exponent
anchors.why: Unbiased operand B exponent; checked for NaN/Inf/zero, summed into z_exponent.

anchors.name: z_mantissa
anchors.why: Result mantissa normalized and rounded before packing into z.

anchors.name: z_exponent
anchors.why: Result exponent (sum of operands), adjusted for underflow, normalize, round, overflow.

anchors.name: z_sign
anchors.why: Result sign as XOR of operand signs.

anchors.name: guard_bit
anchors.why: Guard bit controlling round-to-nearest increment and normalization shift-in.

anchors.name: round_bit
anchors.why: Round bit participating in round-up decision.

anchors.name: sticky
anchors.why: OR of discarded product bits; participates in round-up decision.

groups.name: phase_sequencer
groups.description: Free-running counter selecting the active computation phase.

groups.name: unpack_normalize
groups.description: Field extraction, special-case detection, denormal handling and normalization of operands.

groups.name: mantissa_multiply
groups.description: Mantissa multiplier, exponent adder and sign XOR.

groups.name: round_pack
groups.description: Result normalization, guard/round/sticky rounding, overflow handling and IEEE packing.
